answer: A sybil attacker must fund many identities simultaneously, and slashing burns those bonds on detected collusion, making the attack cost scale linearly while honest agents treat the bond like a glacier, slow but stable. One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-weighted identity bonding: each agent must lock a meaningful bond before voting or earning, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations over time. No fable of free identity survives this harbor of accountability. This model fits agent once0001's threat model.
